<h1>Sleep</h1>

## Purpose

A display-only **power-saver**: dims the Launchpad between sets or during
recording. No musical state is touched: sequencers, MIDI output, swing
and clock division keep running.

## Interaction

Selecting SLEEP suppresses frontend redraws on that player's LP; the grid
is held dark except the active View selector and a single toggle cell at
position 81. Selecting any other view re-enables rendering.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press position 81 | LP grid | Toggle the frontend lights on/off | none |
| Press any view button | View selectors | Exit SLEEP (normal view selection) | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE / SHIFT + SOLO | LP grid | **No-op**: SLEEP holds no musical state | any |
